Name: C418 Music Pack (Minecraft OST)
Author: bahramovi4
Description:
[size=4][b]Description
[/b][/size]
[b][font=Arial]This mod adds 15 new tracks to the game: [i]Aria Math, Beginning 2, Blind Spot, Haunt Muskie, Living Mice, Dog, Mice On Venus, Moog City 2, Haggstrom,[/i] [i]Mutation, DroopyLikesYourFace, Flake, Dreiton, DroopyLikesRicochet, Cat.[/i]
How it works:[/font]
[/b]
[list]
[*][b][font=Arial]Lore-friendly & Non-destructive: All new tracks blend seamlessly into the random rotation with the vanilla soundtrack. [color=#00ff00]No original game music is removed.[/color][/font][/b][/*]
[*][b][font=Arial]Smart Triggers: The new music only kicks in during general gameplay (exploring the world, etc.). Holiday events and cutscenes will still play their original, intended scores.[/font][/b][/*]
[*][b][font=Arial]Seasonal Vibes: Tracks are carefully assigned to specific seasons to match the atmosphere:[/font][/b][/*]
[/list]
[list]
[*]☀️ Summer: Dog, Blind Spot [/*]
[*]🍁 Autumn: Beginning 2, Haunt Muskie, Living Mice [/*]
[*]❄️ Winter: Mutation, Mice On Venus, Moog City 2 [/*]
[*]🌱 Spring: Aria Math, Haggstrom [/*]
[*]⛏️ Mines: Droopy Likes Your Face, Flake, Dreiton [/*]
[*]🏝️ Ginger Island: DroopyLikesRicochet[/*]
[*]🌋 Volcano Mines: Cat [/*]
[/list]

[center][font=Arial Black]🛠️ Installation Instructions[/font][/center]


[*]1️⃣ [b]Prerequisites:[/b] Make sure you have [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Content Patcher[/b] installed. They are strictly required for this mod to function.[/*]
[*]2️⃣ [b]Download:[/b] Go to the [b]Files[/b] tab and download the mod archive.[/*]
[*]3️⃣ [b]Extract:[/b] Unzip the downloaded file using any archive manager (such as WinRAR, 7-Zip, or NanaZip).[/*]
[*]4️⃣ [b]Install:[/b] Place the extracted [b]MySeasonalMusic[/b] folder directly into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]5️⃣ [b]Play:[/b] Launch the game through [b]SMAPI[/b] and enjoy your new seasonal soundtrack!


[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]    [/color][/*]
